title: Rosalind and the Autopsy
author: B. M. Joubert
blurb: Gideon Yarrow, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the statute expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
